miniAppNote.text: A custom app works in two messengers at once: Telegram and MAX, a Russian messenger. One price: we write the app once for both. The industry app includes only Telegram; you can add a MAX version for {max}. For that, you register your company in MAX (we send step-by-step instructions) and we connect the rest. Then MAX reviews the app. MAX decides how long the review takes, so that time is not part of our deadline.

pricing.caseOffer: We are a new studio and we need examples of our work. So our first five clients get the “case-study price” (a case study is an example of our work): the price of any plan from the price list and of a logo is 30% lower. A plan is a ready package from the price list, for example “Start”, a one-page site. Options, paid extras such as online payment, launching the app in the MAX messenger as well, support after launch and work you ask for beyond the contract stay at the regular price. We give the discount right away: the contract states the discounted price, and all payments are calculated from it. We will tell you how many spots are left when we reply to your request. In return we ask for two things. First, you let us show your site, app or logo as an example of our work, without your customers' data. Second, before you sign the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted, you write a review of how the work went. Any review, including a critical one: we publish critical reviews the same way as positive ones. Did not write a review? The price stays the same, and there is nothing to pay extra. Ask us to remove the example and the review, and we take them off our site and social media within 3 working days; the discount stays.

basics.analytics: We connect GA4 and Yandex Metrica, the site analytics services. You see how many leads came in and from where: ads, social networks or search. Run an ad and you will see whether it brings leads from the site. Only visitors who allowed analytics in the cookie window at the bottom of the site are counted
basics.privacy: A cookie notice, a message telling visitors that the site remembers their actions, and the texts required by data protection law: a privacy policy and the consent a customer gives when sending a request. We prepare the texts with you, and you publish them as the site owner: you collect your customers' data, and the law holds you responsible
basics.hosting: We set up the domain, a secure connection (SSL) and hosting and hand them over to you. You pay for the domain and hosting directly: the hosting provider monthly, the domain registrar once a year. Paid services, such as an online booking service, are also on you. Before the contract we work out what that comes to for you per year
basics.sources: We hand over the source code: all the files your site, admin panel and app are built from. With them you can change the site and move to another developer without us. Everything we made specifically for you, the code, the style drawn for you and our texts, becomes yours on the day you pay the full price. Until then you can use the site for free. If the final payment is more than 30 days late, we send a reminder; if there is still no payment 10 working days later, this right ends. Part of the site comes from our own ready-made work shared across all our projects: the admin panel, the section where you change texts, photos and prices yourself, modules, that is, ready program blocks, templates of our demos and ready-made styles. They stay ours, but you get the right to use them in your site for free and with no time limit: to change them, hand the code to another developer and pass this right on to a new owner of the site. We list this ready-made work in the acceptance certificate
basics.revisions: Three rounds of revisions included. A round is all your comments in one list, and we make all of it. Revisions are texts, photos, the color of individual blocks and buttons, the order of blocks; new pages, features and a whole new style are separate work
basics.warranty: A one-year warranty from the day you accepted the work and signed the acceptance certificate. All year we fix for free anything that broke through our fault or does not work the way the contract says. The most urgent breakdown is when through our fault the site does not open or leads do not arrive. We take it on first, before all our other work. In our first reply to your message we name the day it will be fixed, and you confirm it or suggest your own; the same goes for other bugs. The warranty does not cover outages at the hosting provider, the company whose server the site runs on, failures of the domain, the site's address, or of third-party services such as Telegram or a booking service, or breakdowns caused by you or other people changing the site's code. Nor does it cover third-party scripts, pieces of someone else's code such as a chat window, added to the site after you signed the acceptance certificate, or planned updates of the software the site runs on: its authors release new versions from time to time. If such work is not part of your support, a separate monthly fee, it costs $90 an hour: we first show you the cause of the breakdown, then name the total, never charge more than that and start only if you agree. If finding the cause takes more than an hour, we name its price in advance too and start after you agree. Errors in the domain and hosting setup that we did are our fault, and we fix them for free. A dangerous vulnerability in third-party software the site runs on, a weak spot someone could use to break into the site, we close for free all through the warranty year, even if that means updating the software: we do not count such an update as planned. A dangerous one is one the software's authors themselves have marked as dangerous. Without support we do not track such news: heard about one? Write to us. A vulnerability in our own code is our bug, and we fix it for free like any other. Texts and photos you change through the admin panel, the section of the site where you edit texts, photos and prices yourself, do not void the warranty.
basics.training: An admin panel, where you change texts, photos and prices yourself, and add or remove items: dishes, services, doctors. A guide and a screencast: how to work in the admin panel and read leads and analytics
basics.deadline: The deadline goes into the contract. If we are late through our fault, we cut the price by 2% for each day of delay, weekends and public holidays included, 20% at most. That amount comes off the final payment. It is calculated from the price you pay under the contract, options included. process.heading: How we build a one-page site in 4 days
process.contractNote: We fix all four in the contract

brief.title: Choosing a style and the top of the home page
brief.text: After the start date we show the top of the home page, the part people see first, in three styles. You pick one, and from that day the deadline runs: that is day 1. On the same day we turn that top part into a real page you can open on your phone. You send your comments on it in one list: that is the first of three rounds of revisions. Comments on the rest of the page come in the second and third rounds.

concept.title: The whole site on a temporary link
concept.text: We make your first-round revisions and build the whole site: every section, the form where customers leave requests, and visitor analytics. For now the site opens on a temporary link, so you can review it before launch. You send the second list of comments.

staging.title: Revisions and the speed test
staging.text: We make your second-round revisions and run a trial speed test on the temporary link: Google's test gives a page a score from 0 to 100. We send you the reports, you make the second payment of 40% and send the third and final list of comments. The required 90 is measured on launch day, on your own address.

launch.title: Launch and a one-year warranty
launch.text: We make your third-round revisions and move the site to your web address (domain): now everyone can see it. We test the speed again, this time there. We hand over the passwords and all the code: you can change the site or pass it to another developer without us. You sign the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted, and pay the final 30%. Then comes a one-year warranty.

materials.title: Materials
materials.text: Before the contract we send a list of what the site needs: texts, photos, a logo. Everyone fills in the questionnaire about their business: we draw the styles from the answers. No texts of your own? We write them from the same questionnaire and a talk with you. That is included in the price, but the site will be ready 2 days later. The styles, the options for how the site looks, come on time; the texts do not affect them: we show them within 2 working days after the start date, the day in the contract when we start your order. No photos of your own? We put in temporary ones from photo banks, sites where businesses buy photos. Texts we write, you see every time we show you the site: check the prices, addresses and services in them, only you know those.

prepayment.title: Prepayment and start date
prepayment.text: The contract sets a start date: the day we have time free for your site. You pay the prepayment, 30% of the price in the contract ($600 on a $2,000 price), within 3 working days after signing the contract. By the start date you send your answers to the questionnaire and the materials for the styles, your logo and brand colors if you have them; the rest by the dates in the contract. Late with the prepayment, the questionnaire or the materials? The work waits, and we agree on a new start date with you. The prepayment is not lost: it counts toward the payment. The new date does not suit you? Until you pick a style, you can cancel, and within 10 working days we refund the whole prepayment.

style.title: Choosing a style
style.text: A style is how the site looks: colors, fonts, the shape of buttons and blocks. The contract sets a start date: the day we have time free for your site. By that date we need three things: the prepayment, your answers to the questionnaire about your business and the materials for the styles, your logo and brand colors if you have them. Late with the prepayment, the questionnaire or the materials? The work waits, and we agree on a new start date with you. Once everything is in, within 2 working days after the start date we show the top of your home page, what is visible right away, in three different styles. For example, if the start date is a Monday, we show the styles by Wednesday. None of them fit? 2 working days after your reply we show three more. None of those fit either? You can take a ready-made style or close the contract, and then we refund the whole prepayment within 10 working days. You can also take a ready-made style right away: one of the five styles of this site (the “Style” button switches them) or the style of our demo, a ready example site we made to show what we do. Another client may pick a ready-made style too, but a style you pick from the ones drawn for you is yours alone.

refusal.title: If you change your mind
refusal.text: Changed your mind before picking a style? Email us, and within 10 working days we refund the whole prepayment. Changed your mind later? You pay only for the work done, at $90 for each hour of our work. Within 3 working days after your email we send a list: what was done, how many hours it took and what it costs. The list also includes the time spent on the style options we drew for you, and once paid for, they are yours too. Even if the hours add up, you pay no more than 70% of the contract price of the site, without a logo for the work done until we have made your second list of changes, that is, the second round of edits. After the second round, no more than 90%. For example, with a price of $2,000: no more than $1,400 before the second round and no more than $1,800 after. Payments you have made count: paid more than the work done costs? We return the extra within 10 working days. Paid less? You pay the rest, also within 10 working days. Once the work done is paid for, the rights to it pass to you, and within 3 working days we hand over everything we have done.

deadlines.title: Deadlines in the contract
deadlines.text: The contract sets two dates. The first is when we show the styles, the options for how the site looks: within 2 working days after the start date. The second is the deadline for the site: it runs from the day you pick a style, and the days for showing the styles do not count toward it. A delay in showing the styles does not lower the price, but until you pick a style you can cancel and get the whole prepayment back within 10 working days. If through our fault we hand over the site after the deadline, you pay less. The price goes down by 2% for each day of delay, weekends and public holidays included. In total it goes down by no more than 20%, even if we are more than 10 days late. We count the percentage from the price of the site in the contract including options, paid extras such as online payment. A logo in the same contract is not included. We take this amount off the final payment: you simply pay less. For example, with a price of $2,000, being 2 days late means $80 off, and 10 days or more means $400 off.

pauses.title: When the clock stops
pauses.text: We pause the clock while we wait for your reply, materials or payment: the delivery date moves by the same number of days, with no penalties for you. Asked for something that is not in the contract, such as a new page? First we name the price and the new deadline; neither changes without your consent. A round of edits is your list of comments, and we make all of it. If the list holds so much work that we cannot make the delivery date, we tell you before we start how many days the deadline moves and what in the list takes the most time: you can drop it or, if you still have rounds left, move it to the next one, and then the deadline stays. Those days do not count as a delay, and the price does not go down for them. If we are late through our fault, the price goes down, as in the “Deadlines in the contract” card on this page. If the site loads slowly and we work on it until Google's speed test gives it 90 points out of 100, those days count toward the deadline too: late because of that work? The price goes down too.

silence.title: If we hear nothing for a long time
silence.text: If for 30 days in a row you do not answer our question or do not make a payment, we may close the contract by sending you an email. Closed before you pick a style? We refund the whole prepayment. Closed later? We settle up as in the “If you change your mind” card on this page: you pay only for the work done, at $90 for each hour of our work.

speed.title: Website speed
speed.text: On launch day we test the speed again with Google's test, this time on your address: we run it three times in a row, and each time it needs 90 out of 100 or more. We attach the result to the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted. Below 90 because of our code or the way we set up the hosting, the server the website runs on? We fix it for free and do not hand over the work until it reaches 90. If the cause is not on our side, such as a hosting outage or code you added yourself, we show it to you: we send the test reports, the pages with the test results, and write the cause into the certificate. Disagree with the cause? Reply to the email with the certificate within 10 working days, and we sort it out before it is signed. No reply within 10 working days means the work is accepted. A domain is the site's address on the internet, like mrshkn.com. If after the third round of edits you cannot give us access to it for more than 10 working days, we hand over the work on a temporary link, our test address. Once access appears, we move the site to your address at no extra cost, test the speed there and, if needed, improve it under the warranty. A third-party widget, a window from another service such as online booking or a map, slows pages down. If you asked for one, we tell you before the contract what score we promise with it; if you ask later, we tell you before we add it.

acceptance.title: How you accept the work
acceptance.text: We email you the acceptance certificate, a document saying the work is accepted. Within 10 working days, sign it or tell us what does not work the way the contract says. We fix that at no extra charge within 5 working days and send the certificate again; wishes that are not in the contract are not a reason not to sign. No reply within 10 working days? The work counts as accepted, as if you had signed: the warranty starts that day, and it is time to pay the final 30%.

warranty.title: A one-year warranty
warranty.text: For a year from the day you signed the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted, we fix for free anything that broke through our fault or does not work the way the contract says: for example, requests stop coming from the form because of a bug in our code, or the speed drops below 90 points because of our code. If we believe a breakdown is not our fault, we first show you the cause, what broke and why, and only then name the price of the repair; we start only if you agree. If finding the cause takes more than an hour, we name its price in advance too and start after you agree. More in the “If it is not our fault” card on this page. Texts and photos you change in the admin panel, the section for your own edits, do not void the warranty.

repairs.title: How fast we fix things
repairs.text: Message us on Telegram or by email; the contacts are in the contract. The most urgent breakdown is when through our fault the site does not open or requests do not arrive. We take it on first, before all our other work. In our first reply to your message we name the day it will be fixed, and you confirm it or suggest your own. Other bugs that are our fault we also fix for free all through the warranty year, and we name the timing the same way, in our first reply.

notOurFault.title: If it is not our fault
notOurFault.text: Not our fault means, for example, that another developer changed the site's code, a third-party service (Telegram, an online booking service, a payment service) broke or changed its rules, or the hosting provider, the company the site's server is rented from, had an outage. We fix such things for a separate fee: $90 an hour. We first name the total, never charge more than that, and start the repair only if you agree.

upkeep.title: Updates and backup copies of the website
upkeep.text: The software the site runs on is updated by its authors from time to time. Planned updates and backups, snapshots of the site with all its data, are part of support: a separate monthly fee, optional. A dangerous vulnerability is another matter: a weak spot found in the software that someone could use to break into the site. We close such spots for free all through the warranty year, even if you did not take support. A dangerous one is one the software's authors themselves have marked as dangerous. Heard about one? Write to us, and we close it for free. Without support we do not track such news ourselves. The warranty does not depend on support: we fix bugs in our code for free all year without it. But without support we do not make backups. After a failure we rebuild the site from the code: free if the failure is our fault, $90 an hour if it is the hosting's. Whatever appeared after launch, requests and bookings in the admin panel, texts and photos you changed, may be lost. Requests that already reached you by email stay there. With support we restore the site from a backup, and that is part of the monthly fee.

audit.title: Check your site
audit.lead: Send us your website address — we’ll check how fast it loads on a phone and send you up to five tips on what to change to make it faster. If your site is already fast, we’ll tell you so.
audit.why: If a site takes too long to load on a phone, some visitors leave before it opens.
audit.text: It’s free, and you don’t have to order a website from us afterwards. Within an hour during business hours we’ll confirm we got your request, and you’ll get the results within one business day. We work weekdays, 10 am to 7 pm Moscow time (UTC+3). We check one site per request, on any platform, including Wix and WordPress — though we don’t rework sites like these ourselves; we build new ones. The results go only to you, and we won’t show them anywhere without your consent.

audit.studios: The home pages of 54 web studios in the Kaliningrad region — companies that build websites — scored 72.5 out of 100 in this test on a phone: that’s the median site, half of the studios scored lower and half higher. 12 of the 54 studios scored 90 or above. Checked on October 30, 2026.¹
audit.studiosNote: ¹ On October 23, 2026 we compiled a list of 59 web studios in the region (not counting our own). On October 30 we ran their home pages through Google PageSpeed Insights on mobile: three runs in a row per site, taking the middle of the three results — not the best and not the worst. Google’s test couldn’t check five sites, so 54 were counted. Three of those five also failed to open in our earlier check; one scored 100 in it, and another scored 69 and 78 in two runs. With those two included, the median site would have scored between 72.5 and 75. We then ranked the 54 studios by score: the two sites in the middle scored 72 and 73, and we took the average of the two — 72.5.

faq.question: How is a site for your industry different from “Start”?
faq.answer: “Start” is a one-page site. The site for your industry has several pages with sections and features for your industry. For each industry on the list we have a demo, an example of a finished site. We take its structure: the sections and features your industry needs, such as a menu with filters for a cafe or doctors with prices for a clinic. The design is drawn for you: three styles to choose from, as in “Start”. If you like the style of the demo itself, you can take it. Either way the site is yours: with your texts, your photos and on your address. The site for your industry costs more than “Start” and takes longer: it has several pages and features for your industry, while “Start” is one page. It has as many pages as the demo for your industry; a new page is separate work. For a clinic we add a notice about contraindications and the license details, and you are responsible for the medical texts. The deadline is {term}.

faq.question: My industry is not on the list. What now?

faq.question: How many days does a site for your industry take?
faq.answer: In {term}. We count calendar days, weekends included. The deadline starts the day you pick the style of the site, and it is set in the contract. We show three styles within 2 working days after the start date, the day in the contract when we start your order. By that date we need the prepayment, your answers to the questionnaire about your business and the materials for the styles: your logo and brand colors if you have them. If we write the texts, the deadline is 2 days longer. Days we spend waiting for your comments don't count: the delivery date moves by the same number of days. There is no need to rush your reply, but if you do not reply for 30 days in a row, we may close the contract, as in the “If we hear nothing for a long time” card on this page. If we are late through our own fault, we cut the price by 2% for each day of delay, 20% at most. That amount comes off the final payment.

faq.question: Can I add features later?

process.title: Start and choosing a style
process.text: We already have a ready example site for your industry, a demo. We take its sections and features, and draw the top of your home page in three styles. You pick one or take a ready-made style: one of the five styles of this site (the “Style” button) or the style of the demo. The deadline starts the day you pick a style, that is day 1: on that day we start building the site.

process.title: The site in your style
process.text: We build the home page and the other pages in the chosen style, with your texts and photos. The sections and features come from the demo for your industry, and the look from the style you picked. We show it to you, and you send your comments in one list: that is the first of three rounds of revisions.

process.title: The whole site on a temporary link
process.text: We make your revisions and finish all the pages and the form customers use to leave requests; the requests come to you by email, with a notice in Telegram. For now the site opens on a temporary link: you check it before launch and send the second list of comments. We fix everything on the list, and then you make the second payment of 40%.

process.title: Launch and a one-year warranty
process.text: We make your third and final list of comments. We move the site to your web address (domain) and test the speed with Google's test: it needs 90 out of 100 or more. We attach the result to the acceptance certificate. We hand over all the passwords and all the code, so you can change the site without us. You accept the work and pay the final 30%. Then comes a one-year warranty.

materials.title: Materials
materials.text: Before the contract we send a list of what the site needs: texts, photos, a logo and brand colors, the ones on your sign or menu, if you have them. Everyone fills in the questionnaire about their business: we draw the styles from the answers. No texts of your own? We write them from the same questionnaire and a talk with you. That is included in the price, but the site will be ready 2 days later. The styles, the options for how the site looks, come on time; the texts do not affect them: we show them within 2 working days after the start date, the day in the contract when we start your order. No photos of your own? We put in temporary ones from photo banks, sites where businesses buy photos. Texts we write, you see every time we show you the site: check the prices, addresses and services in them, only you know those. If you are a clinic, you are responsible for the medical information on the site: descriptions of services, details of doctors and licenses.

prepayment.title: Prepayment and start date
prepayment.text: The contract sets a start date: the day we have time free for your site. You pay the prepayment, 30% of the price in the contract ($600 on a $2,000 price), within 3 working days after signing the contract. By the start date you send your answers to the questionnaire and the materials for the styles, your logo and brand colors if you have them; the rest by the dates in the contract. Late with the prepayment, the questionnaire or the materials? The work waits, and we agree on a new start date with you. The prepayment is not lost: it counts toward the payment. The new date does not suit you? Until you pick a style, you can cancel, and within 10 working days we refund the whole prepayment.

style.title: Choosing a style
style.text: A style is how the site looks: colors, fonts, the shape of buttons and blocks. The contract sets a start date: the day we have time free for your site. By that date we need three things: the prepayment, your answers to the questionnaire about your business and the materials for the styles, your logo and brand colors if you have them. Late with the prepayment, the questionnaire or the materials? The work waits, and we agree on a new start date with you. Once everything is in, within 2 working days after the start date we show the top of your home page, what is visible right away, in three different styles. For example, if the start date is a Monday, we show the styles by Wednesday. None of them fit? 2 working days after your reply we show three more. None of those fit either? You can take a ready-made style or close the contract, and then we refund the whole prepayment within 10 working days. You can also take a ready-made style right away: one of the five styles of this site (the “Style” button switches them) or the style of our demo, a ready example site we made to show what we do. Another client may pick a ready-made style too, but a style you pick from the ones drawn for you is yours alone.

refusal.title: If you change your mind
refusal.text: Changed your mind before picking a style? Email us, and within 10 working days we refund the whole prepayment. Changed your mind later? You pay only for the work done, at $90 for each hour of our work. Within 3 working days after your email we send a list: what was done, how many hours it took and what it costs. The list also includes the time spent on the style options we drew for you, and once paid for, they are yours too. Even if the hours add up, you pay no more than 70% of the contract price of the site, without a logo for the work done until we have made your second list of changes, that is, the second round of edits. After the second round, no more than 90%. For example, with a price of $2,000: no more than $1,400 before the second round and no more than $1,800 after. Payments you have made count: paid more than the work done costs? We return the extra within 10 working days. Paid less? You pay the rest, also within 10 working days. Once the work done is paid for, the rights to it pass to you, and within 3 working days we hand over everything we have done.

deadlines.title: Deadlines in the contract
deadlines.text: The contract sets two dates. The first is when we show the styles, the options for how the site looks: within 2 working days after the start date. The second is the deadline for the site: it runs from the day you pick a style, and the days for showing the styles do not count toward it. A delay in showing the styles does not lower the price, but until you pick a style you can cancel and get the whole prepayment back within 10 working days. If through our fault we hand over the site after the deadline, you pay less. The price goes down by 2% for each day of delay, weekends and public holidays included. In total it goes down by no more than 20%, even if we are more than 10 days late. We count the percentage from the price of the site in the contract including options, paid extras such as online payment. A logo in the same contract is not included. We take this amount off the final payment: you simply pay less. For example, with a price of $2,000, being 2 days late means $80 off, and 10 days or more means $400 off.

pauses.title: When the clock stops
pauses.text: We pause the clock while we wait for your reply, materials or payment: the delivery date moves by the same number of days, with no penalties for you. Asked for something that is not in the contract, such as a new page? First we name the price and the new deadline; neither changes without your consent. A round of edits is your list of comments, and we make all of it. If the list holds so much work that we cannot make the delivery date, we tell you before we start how many days the deadline moves and what in the list takes the most time: you can drop it or, if you still have rounds left, move it to the next one, and then the deadline stays. Those days do not count as a delay, and the price does not go down for them. If we are late through our fault, the price goes down, as in the “Deadlines in the contract” card on this page. If the site loads slowly and we work on it until Google's speed test gives it 90 points out of 100, those days count toward the deadline too: late because of that work? The price goes down too.

silence.title: If we hear nothing for a long time
silence.text: If for 30 days in a row you do not answer our question or do not make a payment, we may close the contract by sending you an email. Closed before you pick a style? We refund the whole prepayment. Closed later? We settle up as in the “If you change your mind” card on this page: you pay only for the work done, at $90 for each hour of our work.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: On launch day we test the speed again with Google's test, this time on your address: we run it three times in a row, and each time it needs 90 out of 100 or more. We attach the result to the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted. Below 90 because of our code or the way we set up the hosting, the server the website runs on? We fix it for free and do not hand over the work until it reaches 90. If the cause is not on our side, such as a hosting outage or code you added yourself, we show it to you: we send the test reports, the pages with the test results, and write the cause into the certificate. Disagree with the cause? Reply to the email with the certificate within 10 working days, and we sort it out before it is signed. No reply within 10 working days means the work is accepted. A domain is the site's address on the internet, like mrshkn.com. If after the third round of edits you cannot give us access to it for more than 10 working days, we hand over the work on a temporary link, our test address. Once access appears, we move the site to your address at no extra cost, test the speed there and, if needed, improve it under the warranty. A third-party widget, a window from another service such as online booking or a map, slows pages down. If you asked for one, we tell you before the contract what score we promise with it; if you ask later, we tell you before we add it.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.text: We email you the acceptance certificate, a document saying the work is accepted. Within 10 working days, sign it or tell us what does not work the way the contract says. We fix that at no extra charge within 5 working days and send the certificate again; wishes that are not in the contract are not a reason not to sign. No reply within 10 working days? The work counts as accepted, as if you had signed: the warranty starts that day, and it is time to pay the final 30%.

warranty.title: A one-year warranty
warranty.text: For a year from the day you signed the acceptance certificate, the document that confirms the work is accepted, we fix for free anything that broke through our fault or does not work the way the contract says: for example, requests stop coming from the form because of a bug in our code, or the speed drops below 90 points because of our code. If we believe a breakdown is not our fault, we first show you the cause, what broke and why, and only then name the price of the repair; we start only if you agree. If finding the cause takes more than an hour, we name its price in advance too and start after you agree. More in the “If it is not our fault” card on this page. Texts and photos you change in the admin panel, the section for your own edits, do not void the warranty.

repairs.title: How fast we fix things
repairs.text: Message us on Telegram or by email; the contacts are in the contract. The most urgent breakdown is when through our fault the site does not open or requests do not arrive. We take it on first, before all our other work. In our first reply to your message we name the day it will be fixed, and you confirm it or suggest your own. Other bugs that are our fault we also fix for free all through the warranty year, and we name the timing the same way, in our first reply.

notOurFault.title: If it is not our fault
notOurFault.text: Not our fault means, for example, that another developer changed the site's code, a third-party service (Telegram, an online booking service, a payment service) broke or changed its rules, or the hosting provider, the company the site's server is rented from, had an outage. We fix such things for a separate fee: $90 an hour. We first name the total, never charge more than that, and start the repair only if you agree.

upkeep.title: Updates and backups

Planned updates and backups, snapshots of the site with all its data, are part of support: a separate monthly fee, optional. A dangerous vulnerability is another matter: a weak spot found in the software that someone could use to break into the site. We close such spots for free all through the warranty year, even if you did not take support. A dangerous one is one the software's authors themselves have marked as dangerous. Heard about one? Write to us, and we close it for free. Without support we do not track such news ourselves. The warranty does not depend on support: we fix bugs in our code for free all year without it. But without support we do not make backups. After a failure we rebuild the site from the code: free if the failure is our fault, $90 an hour if it is the hosting's. Whatever appeared after launch, requests and bookings in the admin panel, texts and photos you changed, may be lost. Requests that already reached you by email stay there. With support we restore the site from a backup, and that is part of the monthly fee.

A brand book: a rulebook on how to use the logo, colors and fonts. A 25–40 page PDF: margins and grid (the invisible lines everything is aligned to), fonts and text sizes, what photos should look like, what tone to write in
12 icons in the same style, for the site, the menu and social media
A presentation template: a PowerPoint file that also opens in Google Slides. You drop in your own text and photos
5 more layouts. Which ones, we agree together before the contract and put them in it
Icons, the brand book, the presentation template and layouts get one shared round of revisions; the colors and fonts of the style idea are revised within the logo's two rounds

items: First, a short questionnaire about your business: what you sell, to whom and how you want to come across. If answers are missing, we tell you which ones within 1 working day

We hand over all the files of your tier. From the day the logo is paid in full, you use them without limits: on your sign, site, packaging and in ads. You can also change them, yourself or with another designer. We do not give your logo to anyone else, and we do not rework it for others. The unchosen options stay with us: the rights to them do not pass to you, and we may use them in other work

Two checks in the open databases of FIPS, the state institute that keeps the Russian trademark register. A trademark is a logo or name registered to an owner: others may not use the same or a similar one in that owner's field. This is a check, not an opinion from a patent attorney, the specialist who prepares trademark filings
We put the deadline and the price in the contract. If we are late through our own fault, the tier price drops by 2% for each day of delay, by no more than 20% in total
A 12-month warranty on the logo files from the day you accepted the work: found a mistake of ours in them? We fix it for free and agree on the timing in writing
Need more than your tier includes, such as extra drawings, icons or layouts? We charge by the hour: $90 an hour. We name the total before we start and never charge more

Printing, sign fabrication and photo shoots are not included. We prepare the files the print shop and the sign maker need; the drawing of the sign with mounts and lighting is made by the sign maker. No photos of your own? We put free temporary stock photos into the layouts

Our first five clients get 30% off, at the “case-study price” (a case study is an example of our work). In return, you let us show the logo as an example on our site, on social media and in correspondence, and you write a review of the work, any review, including a critical one. We will tell you how many spots are left when we reply to your request

process.title: Questionnaire and contract
process.text: You fill in a short questionnaire about your business. In reply: the price, the deadline, the start date and a draft contract, all before any payment. Without a site the contract is the same, the appendix lists only the logo. You pay 30% of the logo price upfront within 3 working days after signing. The deadline runs from the start date, which needs the prepayment and your questionnaire answers. If they are not in by then, we agree a new date.

process.title: Options to choose from
process.text: Within 2 working days for “Logo”, 3 for “Logo and brand identity” and 4 for “Brand book”, we show 3 different logos (style ideas in “Brand book”). You choose one, and we check for similar trademarks right away. None fits? Within the same time we show 3 more, and the overall deadline shifts by those days. If those don't fit either, we refund the logo prepayment.

process.title: Revisions
process.text: You send your comments in one list: that is a round. The logo gets two rounds, the rest of the tier's materials one shared round. A different idea is hourly work, and we name the price in advance. Without a site you pay 40% of the price: for “Logo” after the second round, for the higher tiers once we have sent all the materials for your round of revisions.

process.title: Files and check
process.text: We check the final version once more. If we find a similar trademark, we change the logo for free, and the deadline shifts by no more than 3 working days. We send the files and the check report. Within 10 working days you sign the acceptance certificate or tell us what is wrong, and we fix it within 5 working days. No reply means the work is accepted. You pay the rest and use the files without limits.

faq.question: Where can I see your logos?
faq.answer: We have not designed logos for clients yet: the studio is new, and examples will appear here after the first orders. That is why the risk is ours until you choose an option: we show 3 different options, and if none fits, 3 more. If those don't fit either, we refund the whole prepayment. And our first five clients get 30% off.

faq.question: How long does a logo take?
faq.answer: “Logo” takes 7 days, “Logo and brand identity” 14 days, “Brand book” 21 days. These are calendar days: weekends and holidays count too. The deadline runs from the start date in the contract, and that date needs the prepayment and your questionnaire answers. While you choose an option or collect comments, the clock stops. If the first 3 options don't fit, the deadline shifts by the days of the second showing. If we find a similar trademark at the end, the deadline shifts by no more than 3 working days.

faq.question: How many revisions can we make?
faq.answer: The logo gets two rounds of revisions; everything else (colors, fonts, pattern, layouts, guidelines, and in “Brand book” also icons, the brand book and the presentation template) gets one shared round. In “Brand book”, the colors and fonts of the style idea are revised together with the logo. A round is one list of your comments: it can have as many points as you like, and we apply it in full. A revision is a change to the chosen option: color, lettering font, shape, details, placement; simplifying or removing details is a revision too. A different idea for the mark, a different drawing technique or a new name at your request is not a revision: we tell you so before the work and quote it by the hour, $90 an hour. We never do such work without your consent. We fix our own mistakes for free.

faq.question: Which files will we get?
faq.answer: The logo for the web and social media (SVG and PNG) and for print shops (PDF and EPS), with colors for screens and for print. Versions for light and dark backgrounds, black and white. A site icon and a profile picture. Higher tiers add the pattern and icons in SVG and PNG, layouts in PDF, PNG and EPS, guidelines in PDF, post and menu templates in Figma and PowerPoint, and the presentation in PowerPoint. Your print shop or sign maker needs a different file format? We re-save it for free within 2 working days. Colors on paper are best checked with a test print at the print shop.

faq.question: Do you check for similar logos?
faq.answer: Yes, twice: a quick check once you choose an option, and a full one when the logo is ready. We search the open FIPS databases for trademarks and applications for them: with a similar name, a similar look and the same imagery, say also with a coffee cup. We do not check cafe and shop names that are not registered as trademarks, or website addresses. This is not an opinion from a patent attorney and not a guarantee of registration: the check sees the databases as of the day it is run. The surest protection for a logo is registering it as a trademark. You pay the fees and the attorney, and you can file in your own name once the logo is paid in full.

faq.question: What if a similar trademark turns up?
faq.answer: We search the open FIPS databases for similar registered trademarks twice: a quick check after you choose an option, and a detailed one when the logo is ready, before we hand over the files. If the second, detailed check finds a similar mark, we change the logo for free. This moves the delivery date by no more than 3 working days.

faq.question: Can we order a logo together with a site?
faq.answer: Yes, in one contract. First we design the logo and check for similar trademarks, then we show the site styles, already with the logo. The site deadline runs as usual, from the day you pick a style: together it takes longer than a site alone, by the time spent on the logo. We finish the rest of the brand identity while we build the site. If the site is ready earlier, at your request we launch it already with the logo. When all the files of the tier are ready, you sign the logo acceptance certificate and pay 70% of the tier price.

faq.question: What if we change our minds halfway?
faq.answer: Until you choose an option, we refund the whole logo prepayment within 10 working days. Ordered together with a site? You can carry on with the site without the logo or close the contract with a full refund of the prepayment. After that you pay only for the work done: $90 an hour, and preparing the options is not billed. We never take more than 70% of the tier price, or more than 90% once we have sent all the files. What you have paid counts toward it, and we refund any excess within 10 working days. Within 3 working days of settling up we hand over everything done. If we refunded the whole prepayment, the options we showed may not be used.

operator.title: Who processes the data
paragraphs: The operator is Veronika Viktorovna Murashkina, self-employed (professional income tax payer), Tax ID (INN) 421815967902, MRSHKN studio. Email for requests: hello@mrshkn.com.

This policy covers the website https://mrshkn.com, the demo websites at *.mrshkn.com and correspondence with the studio by email and on Telegram. We process data under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”.

data.title: What data we collect and why
items: To reply to your request and prepare a proposal. Name, phone, email or messenger account, quiz answers, comment and correspondence. Legal basis: your consent, which you give by sending the request.
To check your website’s speed. Name, contact for the reply and website address from the “Check your site” form. Legal basis: your consent, which you give by sending the form.

To invite a client to leave a review. The client’s email and the project name. Legal basis: the contract or our legitimate interest in hearing the client’s opinion of our work. We do not send advertising to this email.
To publish a review. Name, business or job title, link and review text. Legal basis: the author’s separate consent in the review form.
To count website visits. Cookies, IP address, browser and device information, pages viewed. Legal basis: your consent in the banner on the website.
after: We do not collect information about health, beliefs or biometrics. If you include such information in a request yourself, we will delete it.

storage.title: How long we keep data
items: A request and correspondence, if no contract is signed — 1 year from the last message.
Client data under a contract — 5 years after the contract ends.
A client’s email for a review — 3 years after the acceptance certificate is signed or until you ask us to delete it, whichever comes first.
A published review — until the author withdraws consent.
after: When the period ends or the purpose is achieved, we delete the data within 30 days.

transfer.title: Who we share data with
paragraphs: Requests and other data are stored in the website database on a server in Russia. The Operator has access to them. The server and backups are protected with access keys, passwords and encryption. In addition, data passes through these services:
items: Yandex Mail — correspondence with hello@mrshkn.com;
Telegram — messages, if you write to us on Telegram, and notifications of new requests: name, contact, quiz answers or the website address;
Yandex Metrica — visit counting, only if you have agreed in the banner on the website;
Google Analytics — visit counting, also only after you agree in the banner;
Google PageSpeed Insights — the website address from the “Check your site” form, to check its speed; Google does not receive your name or contact;
Cloudflare — the website sends request notifications to Telegram through this service.
after: We do not sell data or pass it on for other companies’ advertising.

cookies.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The website stores essential cookies in your browser: language, colour theme and your choice in the banner. Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics cookies are switched on only after you agree in the banner. You can refuse in the banner or in your browser settings.

rights.title: Your rights and deleting data
paragraphs: You can find out what data of yours we keep, ask us to correct or delete it, and withdraw your consent. Email hello@mrshkn.com from the email address or account you used to contact us, or give them in the email so that we can find you. We reply within 10 business days. After you withdraw consent, we delete the data within 30 days, except data needed for the contract or by law, for example for taxes. You can file a complaint about us with Roskomnadzor or a court.
